messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>

Subject: Pilot privacy runbook review — network & retention next steps

Hi Emma / Mike — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have a single action list from the discovery:

Summary from call:
- ClearPath will run a short private pilot (non-prod) to validate inference latency and PII handling.
- Non-prod must be air-gapped from public internet; production may be VPC-peered with restricted egress.
- PII types: patient identifiers (name, MRN), DOB, contact info; no full medical images in pilot.
- Retention: must be configurable, default 90 days for pilot; legal may ask for longer for logs.
- Audit/logging: need exportable audit trail (append-only) and token-level request logs retained for 3 years for investigations.

Immediate asks we committed to:
1) We will send a draft runbook (attached) that outlines network boundaries, required firewall rules, and minimal egress destinations. Owner: me (Sean). Target: EOD 2027-07-25.
2) Provide a VPC egress template + suggested ACLs for locked-down private deployments. Owner: Ben Carter. Target: 2027-07-26.
3) Confirm KMS/HSM options and audit log retention SLAs to align with your legal team. Owner: Soojin. Target: 2027-07-27.
4) Schedule a follow-up Tech call with your infra lead to walk the runbook and collect network diagrams. Owner: Soojin. Target: calendar invite by tomorrow.

Attachments: redwood-runbook-draft.pdf (annotated runbook) — note: it contains a proposed deployment topology and minimal outbound endpoints (object storage, telemetry sink, licensing endpoint).

Questions for you while we prepare:
- Can you confirm whether non-prod will be completely air-gapped from your corporate internet, or just restricted (proxy-only)?
- Which cloud region do you prefer for pilot infra (us-east-1 or us-west-2)?

Next steps: I'll drop the runbook into the shared Drive and Ben will send the ACL template. Please flag anything missing.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Sean — appreciate the summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Non-prod (pilot) will be fully air-gapped from corporate internet; we will provide a physically isolated VLAN with jump host access for your engineers.
- For the pilot we prefer us-east-1. Production region TBD.
- Required retention: audit logs and request traces must be retained for at least 3 years. Application-level PII can be purged after 90 days for the pilot but Legal reserves the right to request longer retention for investigatory holds.
- We do require support for HSM-backed key storage (we use a managed HSM) and an ability to export key fingerprints for our compliance team.

I've attached our compliance questionnaire with baseline answers — you'll notice a few gaps about endpoint allowlisting and process around incident notifications. Can Ben / Soojin call these out in the runbook?

Forwarded attachment: clearpath-compliance-questions.xlsx

Emma — thanks for the quick answers, and noted on the HSM requirement. A few technical clarifications and what we'll deliver next: 

1) Egress controls: we will provide a VPC egress ACL template (attached: vpc-egress-template.txt) that only allows outbound to:
   - Your object storage endpoint (signed URL uploads)
   - Our telemetry sink (TLS only, fixed IPs)
   - License verification endpoint (redwood-license.redwood.com)
   We'll annotate routes that are required for updates vs telemetry to minimize blast radius.

2) Air-gapped non-prod: software install can be delivered via a signed offline bundle if you require total isolation. We'll also provide an MD5/SHA fingerprint for validation. Please confirm whether you want the offline bundle or an isolated VPC with restricted egress (we can support both).

3) KMS/HSM: Redwood supports KMS integrations and can be configured to use a customer-managed key. For HSM-backed keys we need the key provisioning fingerprint and the KMS URI. Soojin, can you pick this up with Emma / Legal?

Deliverables and owners: 
- vpc-egress-template.txt (attached) — Owner: Ben — ETA: 2027-07-27
- Signed offline installer + fingerprints (if requested) — Owner: Ben/Infra Eng — ETA: 2027-07-30
- Runbook updated with HSM/KMS notes and incident contact flow — Owner: Soojin — ETA: 2027-07-27

I'll also prepare a short change-control checklist for how we handle retention holds and forensic exports.
